name: Very low illuminance is unpleasant
claim: A review of credible illuminance and colour-temperature experiments found that the only stable rule for pleasant light is to avoid low illuminance.
caveat: The review gives no exact threshold in its abstract; a secondary reading puts the line near 300 lux, which is not confirmed.

sources.title: Fotios 2017, A revised Kruithof graph based on empirical data, LEUKOS 13(1)
